key_insight: The Angular Rotational Counter (ARC) encodes a weighted sum of Boolean functions as accumulated rotations on one objective qubit rather than a multi-qubit objective register.
engineering_relevance: ARC can reduce quantum optimization oracle resources, potentially making quantum-search circuits more practical under qubit and circuit-depth constraints.
method: Translate weighted Boolean objective terms into accumulated single-qubit rotations.
Derive how measurement probabilities relate to the encoded objective value.
Build a state-assignment oracle using a weighted Hamming distance cost function.
evidence_signal: Across 26 state-assignment benchmarks, ARC oracles averaged reductions of 20.8% in qubits, 89.3% in gates, 92.4% in circuit depth, and 90.6% in quantum cost versus corresponding Boolean-based oracles.
watch_item: These oracle resource savings do not establish end-to-end optimization speedups; rotation precision and measurement overhead need assessment.
paper_title: Rotational Encoding of Objective Functions for Quantum Optimization
